title: JAH HelioView 27
description: The JAH HelioView 27 is a Signature concept monitor: a 27-inch 4K Helio IPS panel simulated at 240 Hz with a 0.5 ms overdrive profile. It is an original JAH design study exploring what a no-compromise 4K esports panel could look like. Signature concept only — not a manufactured product.

demo.program:
import math
# JAH HelioView 27: pixel density + uncompressed interface bandwidth estimate
w, h = 3840, 2160            # native resolution
diag = 27              # inches diagonal
refresh = 240        # Hz
ppi = math.hypot(w, h) / diag
# 10-bit color ~= 30 bits per pixel; rough uncompressed bandwidth
gbps = w * h * refresh * 30 / 1e9
print(f"PPI: {ppi:.1f}")
print(f"Uncompressed bandwidth @ {refresh} Hz: {gbps:.1f} Gbps")
need = "HDMI 2.1 / DP 1.4 with DSC" if gbps > 25 else ("DP 1.2 / HDMI 2.0" if gbps > 14 else "DP 1.2 / HDMI 1.4")
print("Interface class needed:", need)
